paragraphs: From Mulhuddart, begin on the Blanchardstown Bypass and take the 1st left onto Old Navan Road
Take the next left to join the slip road follow the ramp straight ahead and bear slightly left back onto the Blanchardstown Bypass
Merge slightly right, stay on the bypass take the off ramp slightly left to exit
Turn left back onto Old Navan Road and follow it for about half a kilometre
Take the next right onto Church Road for a short stop

Continue along Church Road at the roundabout take the slight left exit to remain on Church Road, and take the 1st right into Dromheath Avenue for a low-speed practice section including a turnabout (U-turn) manoeuvre
Leaving Dromheath Avenue turn right at the end of the road onto Church Road
At the Damastown Roundabout take the exit for the unnamed road toward Cruiserath Road and follow it through
At the next roundabout take the slight left onto Blanchardstown Road North and stay on it for around 800 metres
At the following roundabout take the exit left onto Blackcourt Road
Turn left into Sheephill Park take the 1st right onto Westway and the next left into Sheephill Green, where you will practice another turnabout in the estate
Retrace back down Sheephill Green, right onto Westway, and left into Sheephill Park
Turn right onto Blackcourt Road, then at the roundabout take the exit left onto Blanchardstown Road North and follow it for just over a kilometre
Turn right onto Old Navan Road and continue along it, taking the series of short left, slight left and right turns as the road bends
To return toward Mulhuddart, follow Old Navan Road
Take the left and then a right onto Blanchardstown-Tyrrelstown DED 1986
At the roundabout take the exit left onto Damastown Road, continue to the next roundabout and take the exit right onto Parnell Drive
Left again on Parnell Drive at the end of the road turn right, bear slight left and finish on Parnell Drive close to the test centre
